conviction_note: Mild long lean (p_up 55 on a 9% absolute move). Announced Q1 orders of at least $24M run above the ~$22.6M revenue bar, so backlog probably grows again after a flat Q4, and about 17% of shares are short into a stock 57% off its high. Against that: this name sold its last two record prints (-5.0%, -4.3%), and supply constraints (detector lead times, the G5 redesign delay, NGSRI production pushed to FY28) threaten gross margin. Findings sum to +1.4 against a scaled +0.9; the two measurements agree in sign and are not fitted to each other.
bar: Fiscal Q1 2027 (September quarter) revenue of about $22.3-22.6M and EPS of -$0.02 to -$0.03. Two sources agree: Earnings Whispers preview, 2026-11-04 ($22.6M, -$0.02, https://www.earningswhispers.com/article/LPTH/22854), and the Chartmill estimates page ($22.28M, -$0.03, https://www.chartmill.com/stock/quote/LPTH/estimates, snippet only, fetch 403). Chartmill news puts FY27 revenue near $106.9M. StockAlarm shows an outlier of $28M, treated as stale. The company gives no formal guidance (Q4 release, https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0000889971/000143774926030074/ex_922995.htm). The implicit bars are backlog above $110.9M and gross margin near Q4's 39.4%.
positioning_check: Short interest: 11.93M shares and 4.0 days to cover on shortsqueeze.com (https://shortsqueeze.com/?symbol=LPTH, page dated 2026-11-10; the snippet ties the figures to a 2026-10-29 quote; settlement date not shown). Earlier readings: 10.6M shares, 16.8% of float, 3.7 days on 2026-08-21 (equibles.com), and 8.1M on 2026-06-30 (FINRA via curvedtrading). Against 69.96M Class A shares outstanding at 2026-06-30 (Q4 release), that is about 17% of shares and more of float, and it has risen all year. This is a crowded short. Skew: skew_25d_vol_points is null in the baseline. Put/call open interest is 0.43 (call-heavy). ATM IV 122%, straddle 16.8% to the 2026-11-20 expiry, event-implied move 5.19% after netting ordinary vol, against a median reaction of 8.33% over the last 7 prints. Tape: -13.2% over 20 days, -1.0% over 5 days, 57% below the 52-week high, at $7.73 against a June 2026 offering at $14.00. Earnings Whispers lists daily moves of -13.4% (11-05) and +14.8% (11-06); I could not verify them independently.

findings.finding: Orders announced inside fiscal Q1 total at least $24M: an $11M follow-on order for counter-UAS IR cameras and $13M of follow-on optical assembly orders, both in July 2026. That exceeds the ~$22.6M revenue consensus, so book-to-bill should be at least ~1.06 on announced orders alone and backlog should rise above the flat $110.9M (Q4 had $110.6M, the first pause after five quarters of growth). The preview frames a backlog meaningfully above $111M as the test. After quarter end came another $6.3M (10-13, taking that customer above $19M since July 1, double its whole FY26) and an order of undisclosed value for more than 50,000 drone optical assemblies (10-27).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: A record Q4 (revenue +73%, backlog +197% y/y but flat sequentially) fell 4.96% (2026-09-10), and Q3 (revenue +109%) fell 4.32% (2026-05-07). Q2 FY26 (2026-02-11) rose 21.5%. Backlog stalling was the cited cause of the September drop (https://finviz.com/news/415717/lightpaths-july-production-orders-face-first-test-as-backlog-stall-weighs-on-shares).
findings.why_not_priced: The orders are public, but the stock is down ~17% since the last print and 13% over 20 days, so it is priced as though the backlog stall continues. If the market believed backlog would grow again, the stock would not sit near the 52-week-low band, 45% below the June $14 offering, with ~$93M of June-30 cash against a ~$540M market cap. The deconsolidation of China backlog and delivery stretching to CY2027 can hide the growth, which is why this is not sized larger.
findings.independence: The October 13 release gives the customer total since July 1 (https://www.newswire.com/news/lightpath-technologies-receives-additional-6-3-million-follow-on-optical) and the October 27 release the 50k-unit order (https://www.newswire.com/news/lightpath-technologies-secures-order-for-over-50-000-optical-assemblies-for). These are the company's own documents, so they are not independent of the Q4 release.

findings.finding: Teledyne reported on 2026-10-21, after LightPath last spoke. Digital Imaging sales rose 15.0% to $903.0M (14.3% organic), and IR subsystems and cameras for unmanned air and maritime systems grew more than 25%. Orders have exceeded sales for 12 straight quarters. This shows unmanned/counter-UAS IR demand held through the September quarter.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No record of LPTH reacting to a peer read-through. Its own prints have moved on backlog and order flow.
findings.why_not_priced: This is an industry proxy, not a LightPath number. Teledyne is a peer and in part a competitor, not a confirmed counterparty. LPTH fell after the Teledyne print, so the read-through has visibly not been bid.
findings.independence: A different source (https://www.optics.org/news/infrared-imaging-drives-record-sales-and-earnings-at-teledyne) reports the same peer print. It is a proxy only.

findings.finding: The China subsidiary LPOIZ was sold, closing 2026-10-30, for $4.5M payable over five years. It takes about $4.5M a year (~$1.1M a quarter) of third-party revenue out of consolidated results from Q2. The FY27 consensus near $106.9M may not net this out, so the forward bar may need a trim. The release discloses no gain or loss on the sale.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: First divestiture print. Earnings Whispers lists -13.4% on 2026-11-05, the day the closing was announced, then +14.8% on 11-06. I could not verify those moves elsewhere.
findings.why_not_priced: The revenue loss was disclosed in September, but analysts' FY27 numbers (~$107M) may still include it. The divestiture is margin-accretive (cited as one driver of the Q4 39.4% gross margin), which offsets part of the hit, hence the small size.
findings.independence: 8-K filed 2026-11-05 (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/889971/000143774926035272/lpth20261104_8k.htm). Same company, so not independent.

findings.finding: Supply-side risks to Q1 revenue conversion and gross margin, from the Q4 call as summarised: longer detector lead times and tight glass-melting capacity are delaying new products; the G5 camera redesign to BlackDiamond is behind plan; and the customer has pushed out NGSRI timing (Defense Daily, 2026-07-16: Army NGSRI production starts FY2028, with Lockheed and RTX still competing). The preview flags gross margin slipping from 39.4% toward the mid-30s as the downside test.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The September 2026 print (-4.96%) was attributed to the flat backlog and defense program timing. May 2026 (-4.32%) is the same pattern of a strong number sold on timing.
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced: the NGSRI delay and G5 slippage were on the September call and the stock has derated since. What is not priced is how far gross margin falls. If the market priced a margin miss, short interest would be falling into the print rather than rising. Sized small because about 17% of shares are short, so the squeeze is a mechanism of its own.
findings.independence: The Q4 call summary on statementdog (https://statementdog.com/analysis/LPTH/earnings_calls/319705, Chinese-language, snippet only) and the Earnings Whispers preview (https://www.earningswhispers.com/article/LPTH/22854) say the same. Defense Daily is independent of the company.

findings.finding: Short interest is about 11.93M shares (4.0 days to cover), roughly 17% of the 69.96M shares outstanding. It has risen through 2026 (4.1M in April, 8.1M on 06-30, 10.6M on 08-21). Call open interest is twice put open interest, and the stock is 57% off its high and 13% down over 20 days into the print.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Two of the last seven prints were +21.5% (2025-09-25, 2026-02-11), the squeeze-shaped upside tail. The rest ran -4% to -19%.
findings.why_not_priced: Positioning is the price, not information. What it says is that the market's expectation is skewed negative, so a backlog-up print meets shorts who must cover, at 4 days of volume. If the negative had fully cleared, short interest would have been falling.

findings.finding: Germanium is up about 102% in 2026 (SMM, 2026-10-13), with ex-China spot reportedly above $17,000/kg against RMB 27,250/kg domestic (Rare Earth Exchanges, 2026-10-11). That strengthens the case for BlackDiamond chalcogenide substitution, which management will discuss on the call. LightPath also still sells germanium-based IR optics, which partly offsets this as a cost.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Germanium export-control headlines produced LPTH's large 2024-2025 rallies (narrative). There is no print-day record on this line.
findings.why_not_priced: This is macro-to-company transmission, not confirmed in the quarter's numbers. The stock fell through October while germanium hit new highs, so the narrative is not being paid for at present.
findings.independence: https://rareearthexchanges.com/?p=191510 (2026-10-11) is a different source. Both are proxies.

findings.finding: On 2026-09-17 the Department of War awarded LightPath a CLEAR-program prototype agreement to develop BlackDiamond glass as a germanium alternative. Under 10 U.S.C. 4022(f) it can lead to a follow-on production award without further competition. The value was not disclosed.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No earnings-day record. The award was public before the stock's October slide.
findings.why_not_priced: Largely priced, since it is public. The call may quantify it or tie it to design-ins, which the market has not seen.
findings.independence: Same document on finviz (https://finviz.com/news/393123/lightpath-technologies-wins-department-of-war-prototype-agreement-to-advance-germanium-alternatives-for-infrared-imaging), so not independent.

outside_window.finding: China's suspension of its US-specific gallium/germanium export ban expires 2026-11-27. A lapse would revive the germanium-substitution narrative.
Army NGSRI production is planned from FY2028 (11,000 missiles over ten years), and the Lockheed/RTX competition is unresolved. LightPath's NGSRI content depends on Lockheed winning.
The final G5 Infrared earnout is accrued and payable in January 2027 (a cash outflow, already accrued).

searched_and_found_nothing: EDGAR since 2026-08-01 (https://data.sec.gov/submissions/CIK0000889971.json): no S-3, 424B, ATM or Form 144. The only Form 4s are late-filed CFO RSU grants (2026-03-23 and 2026-08-18, filed 09-25 and 10-19), with no open-market insider sales. The Form D of 2026-10-09 is a $10,800 Rule 506(b) sale to one investor, immaterial. There is a DEF 14A of 2026-10-26.
No October 2026 analyst price-target actions found. The latest consensus target is about $14 (MarketBeat, late July 2026).
No source found for a gain or loss on the LPOIZ sale or a held-for-sale impairment in the fiscal 2026 10-K text.
Could not establish why the stock fell on 2026-11-04 or 2026-11-05. The moves come from Earnings Whispers alone.
Q4 FY26 call transcript in English: nasdaq.com returned 503, 247wallst 410, quartr had a summary only, and the statementdog page body was empty.

rejected_candidates.detail: The year cannot be confirmed from the URL or the snippet; it is probably September 2025 and so already in the backlog.

rejected_candidates.candidate: StockAlarm's Q1 FY27 revenue consensus of $28M.
rejected_candidates.detail: Two other sources (Earnings Whispers 2026-11-04 and Chartmill) agree on $22.3-22.6M. The $28M is stale or an outlier and is not used as the bar.

rejected_candidates.candidate: Lockheed won a Future Interceptor OTA on 2026-10-29.
rejected_candidates.detail: Future Interceptor is a program separate from NGSRI. No document ties LightPath to it.

baseline_tension: There is no skew number. The tape (-13% over 20 days, 57% off the high) and the rising short interest price a negative outcome, while announced bookings above the revenue bar cut against that. The lean is therefore against positioning, and p_up is held at 55 rather than higher because this name has sold its last two record prints.
lessons_applied: Lesson 1 (a verified fact is not a predicted reaction; this name sold its last two record prints): the Q1 bookings finding cut from +1.0 to +0.7.
Lesson 5 (a proxy is filed small): the Teledyne read-through cut from +0.5 to +0.3 and germanium from +0.3 to +0.2.
Lesson 7 (crowded short, about 17% of shares, 4 days to cover): the supply/margin negative cut from -1.0 to -0.7.
Lesson 6: the bar is sourced to two agreeing estimates, so no cap. The germanium ban expiry, NGSRI production and the earnout are in outside_window.
